S#1 윤호 방 (밤 / 안)
어둡고 새벽. 윤호, 침대 속에서 깊은 잠을 자고 있다.
어둠 속에서 바닥에서 웅덩이가 번져나온다.
웅덩이 위로 반투명한 손이 천천히 솟아오른다.
이어 여러 물고기 인간들이 나타나 방 안을 가득 채운다.
몸은 인간과 유사하지만 빛 맞으면 무지개빛 나는 비늘로 가득하고, 머리는 누가봐도 물고기.
비늘 위에는 액이 떨어지는데, 물에 나와 공기로부터 보호해주는 역할을 하는 것 같다.
그들의 피부는 유리처럼 빛나고, 움직임은 느리고 유영하는 듯하다.

S#2 윤호 방 (밤 / 안)
윤호, 눈을 크게 뜨고 몸을 굳힌 채 침대에 누워 있다.
주변 소리, 모두 수중처럼 왜곡된다.
그때, 꿈에서 봤던 물고기 인간들이 침대를 동그랗게 둘러싼다.
그들의 눈동자가 반짝인다.
윤호는 공포가 가득한 눈으로 물고기 인간들을 쳐다본다. 너무 놀래서 소리가 나오지 않는다.
물고기 인간들이 말을 하는데 물속에서 말하는 것처럼 웅얼 거리는 언어다.
적어도 해치러 오지 않았다는 것을 느낀 윤호, 무슨 말을 하는지 궁금해한다.
중앙에 있는 물고기 인간이 손끝을 들어올린다.
윤호의 머릿속에 전자음 같은 울림이 번진다.
마치 물고기 인간이 부르는 것 같다.
윤호는 망설이다가 용기를 내서 손끝을 내민다.
윤호와 물고기 인간이 악수 하는 순간, 물고기 인간은 윤호의 손목을 확잡고 화면이 왜곡되며 흰색 플래시.

breakdown.logline: Awakened by fish-headed visitors from his dreams, Yunho struggles past terror and incomprehensible speech to answer their invitation, only for a tentative handshake to become a forceful wrist-grab that fractures the room into white light.

beats.summary: A dark puddle spreads across the floor beside the sleeping Yunho
A translucent humanlike hand rises from the puddle
Fish-headed humanoids emerge and occupy the room
Yunho awakens rigid with fear as ordinary sounds become underwater distortions
The visitors form a circle around his bed, their eyes catching the light
Their restrained gestures and muffled speech persuade Yunho that they may not intend harm
The central visitor raises its fingertips toward Yunho
An electronic-sounding summons reverberates inside Yunho’s head
Yunho overcomes his hesitation and decides to respond
Yunho extends his fingers toward the visitor’s offered hand
Their hands meet in an apparently gentle handshake
The visitor abruptly clamps Yunho’s wrist, triggering distortion and a white flash

subjects.name: Yunho
subjects.appearance: slender build, short dark hair with a rounded crown, loose middle-gray long-sleeved pajamas, bare hands, partly covered by the duvet at first appearance
signature_features: narrow frame inside oversized pajamas and a compact rounded hair silhouette remain recognizable from any angle.

subjects.name: Central visitor
subjects.appearance: unusually tall, narrow humanlike torso and limbs, disproportionately broad oval fish head, translucent webbed hands, pale glasslike skin covered in overlapping scales; rainbow iridescence reads as fine alternating silver-to-dark bands, and clear viscous coating beads between the scales
signature_features: oversized oval head, elongated forearms, and a continuous high dorsal ridge distinguish its silhouette from every angle; round reflective eyes sit on the sides of its head.

subjects.name: Fish circle
subjects.appearance: adult humanlike proportions, shorter and stockier than the Central visitor, pointed fish heads, translucent webbed hands, glasslike scaled bodies with the same silver-to-dark iridescent bands and hanging clear droplets
signature_features: large pointed heads and short triangular dorsal fins produce a consistent, recognizable silhouette from any angle; their eyes carry small, sharp reflections.

subjects.name: Puddle
subjects.appearance: nearly black, shallow, mirrorlike liquid with a thin silver edge; initially approximately pillow-width, with an irregular oval body and two narrow trailing lobes
signature_features: exceptionally flat profile and forked trailing outline distinguish it from an ordinary floor shadow.

spec.shot_name: Puddle spreading beside sleeping Yunho

subject_states.subject: Puddle
subject_states.state: Manifested as several nearly black, shallow, mirrorlike pools scattered across the visible floor, each edged in thin silver. The main pool beside the bed spreads from pillow-width toward small-rug width, retaining its irregular oval body and two narrow trailing lobes. spec.backdrop: Dark floorboards dominate the foreground; the bed, pale pillow, and blank rear wall occupy the upper-right portion of the frame.
spec.action: Yunho sleeps beneath the duvet while the main puddle’s silver-edged perimeter creeps outward across the boards. Throughout the visible floor, several smaller pools gently bubble: clear droplets rise, fall back, and send overlapping concentric ripples across their surfaces, giving the floor the uncanny feeling of a lake disturbed by falling water droplets.
spec.transition: Hard cut to the puddle’s surface.
